name.description: The name of the component. Optional field for informational purposes only.

dataSpec.description:
The data settings for this component.

@uiSdlDesignerCustomRenderer(rendererType='')

disableDataRequestOnFirstRender.description: Disable if you want to avoid sending any and all requests for this component on first render.

triggersRegistered.description: Whether the effect triggers and epics have been registered

wrapWithMetadataId.description: Whether to wrap the component with a div which has a class name of its metdata id. Useful for targeting with css.

actions.description: The actions to display for this node

checked.description: Whether the node should be checked or not

children.description: The children nodes of this node

content.description: The content to display for this node

descendantsIds.description: An array of the ids of the descendants of this node, used internally for performance reasons

disabled.description: Whether the node should be disabled or not

expanded.description: Whether the node should be expanded or not

icon.description: Icon to display before the content of this node

iconTooltip.description: the tooltip text for the node icon

indeterminate.description: Whether the node should render its checkbox in the indeterminate state (this is, the "dash" icon)

iconColor.description: Color for the icon to display

image.description: Path to the image to display before the content of this node. If defined, it will take precedence over the #icon

overlayIcon.description: The icon to overlay on top of the image

overlayIconColor.description: The color of the overlayed icon

parent.description: Parent node of the current node

selected.description: Whether the node is the selected node of the tree (only one node can be selected)

selectable.description: Whether the node should be selectable or not. If the tree is selectable, this property will be ignored

expandable.description: Whether the node should be expandable or not.

showCheckbox.description: Whether the node should show a checkbox or not

showChildrenCount.description: Whether the title should show the number of children this node has (if any)

showMinimizedChildren.description:
Whether the node should show a minized map of its children overlay icons when it is collapsed.
This is useful for giving visibility to children state from the parent node

statuses.description: The different statuses aggregated based on the children nodes.

rightIcon.description: Icon that is rendered to the right of the node content.

rightImage.description: Path to the right image to display after the content of this node. If defined, it will take precedence over the #rightIcon
